messages:
rachel wong: Heads-up: BlackHatSec requested a mid-May pen test. They need RBAC mappings, KMS grant pattern, and pre-window audit exports. Can we define a handoff protocol?

daniel park: I can own RBAC. Proposal: create 'pen_test_assessor_temporal' role with explicit ARNs for inference-api, model-blobstore, and metrics read. No ListAll or wildcards.

emma roberts: Audit plan: snapshot CloudTrail + app access logs, copy to locked bucket in another account, enable object lock, and provide a presigned GET for vendor. Retention = 1y.

vendor-blackhat: We'll perform authenticated replay + low-latency fuzzing. Need an assume-role and a replay service account. No secret reads.

daniel park: We'll enforce assume-role with external ID + limited session (30m) and restrict source CIDR. Also add a deny on kms:CreateGrant.

emma roberts: SIEM baseline: I'll run queries for high-rate inference calls and unusual auth patterns 72h pre-window and post baseline.

k8s-bot: Note: scheduled cluster upgrades during May 13-14. Please confirm no overlapping maintenance.

rachel wong: Good catch. I'll move to freeze those windows or shift the test by a day. Retest criteria: PR merged, staging rollout, regression tests, reproduction doc, audit export showing no hits for exploit signatures.

daniel park: KMS pattern: create grant with EncryptionContext = {"pen_test":"true"}, retire after 120h. Provide CLI snippet in PR.

emma roberts: Evidence upload flow: presigned POST with SSE-KMS enforced and object lock. I'll add upload instructions in tracker.

rachel wong: Action items: daniel = RBAC + role/trust policy; emma = audit export + presigned upload; daniel+ops = kms grant; rachel = vendor coordination & change-freeze. ETA Friday EOD.

vendor-blackhat: We'll send IP ranges and a short attack plan by tomorrow. Expect a smoke run first hour.

rachel wong: Thanks. If blockers, update the pen-test ticket in tracker and @mention me.
